# dnsgate_me (Data Source)

The identity of the provider as the gate sees it (`GET /api/v1/me`): roles, teams and the default team it writes for.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dnsgate_me" "this" {}

output "default_team" {
  value = data.dnsgate_me.this.default_team
}

output "teams" {
  value = data.dnsgate_me.this.teams
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) `human`, `pipeline`, `workload`...
- `default_team` (String) Team the identity writes for unless a resource sets `team`: owner of the RRsets it creates. Gates without teams do not report it: it is then the first of `teams`, the team those gates write for. Empty when the identity has no team.
- `groups` (List of String) Groups of the identity.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `roles` (List of String) Roles granted by the gate policy.
- `subject` (String) `<issuer>:<subject id>`.
- `teams` (List of String) Teams the identity acts for, the default team first.
